I replied to Tobias in his DM. I told him his standing call with the Marrow Fieldworks team about the Tamarack rollout is Thursdays at 9:30 from now on, and that I'd keep it between us.

I didn't save a separate note for it. The workspace brain stores every DM with me automatically, so his message is already there, and only he can see it. I didn't touch his calendar or post anything anywhere else.
